Privacy

This website is a private preview and is not yet a publicly approved website of the accommodation operator.

Your travel draft stays with you.

The trip planner processes entries in your browser. It does not send them to the host or store them in its own database. Copying text places it on your clipboard only after your action.

External links are subject to the privacy information of the respective provider. Airbnb, maps and excursion providers are not embedded. No additional analytics or marketing services are used.

Final information about the data controller, hosting and actual processes must be completed before public release. Sign-in for this private preview is managed by the hosting provider.
